news.body: The Arizona Cardinals D/ST allowed 36 points on 437 total yards on Sunday against the 49ers.
news.head: Arizona Cardinals D/ST struggles Sunday
news.impact: It was a field day for Brock Purdy and the 49ers offense with four passing touchdowns and a rushing score. The Cardinals defense remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: The Arizona Cardinals D/ST was completely outmatched against the Seattle Seahawks offensive attack, losing 34-3 in the process. The unit managed just one sack and a fumble recovery.
news.head: Arizona Cardinals D/ST run over by Seattle offense in Week 2
news.impact: After a half-decent showing against the Chargers, the Cardinals defense was put back in their place by the much better run Seattle offense. Arizona’s lack of talent on the defensive side of the ball screams that they should be well off of streaming radar, and that was evident on Sunday.

news.body: The Cardinals D/ST limited the Chargers to just 14 points and 268 yards of total offense in Sunday's 26-14 win.
news.head: Cardinals defense does a nice job in Week 1 win
news.impact: The Cardinals pulled off an impressive road victory in Week 1, and their defense played a huge part in it. The unti sacked Chargers QB Justin Herbert three times and forced a pair of turnovers. Arizona will certainly gain some extra attention after this performance, but will have its hands full with the defending Super Bowl champs in Week 2. The Seahawks will be without starting quarterback Sam Darnold (glute), though.

news.body: The Arizona Cardinals are expected to hire Los Angeles Rams offensive coordinator Mike LaFleur as their next head coach.
news.head: Arizona Cardinals plan to hire Mike LaFleur as HC
news.impact: The Rams will be left searching for a new offensive coordinator again as the Cardinals work on finalizing a deal with LaFleur. The Rams had one of the best offenses in the NFL in 2025 and quarterback Matthew Stafford was an MVP candidate. Additionally, LaFleur is familiar with the division.

news.body: The Ravens D/ST allowed 31 points while picking up one sack and forcing one turnover in a 34-31 win over the Cowboys in Brazil in Week 3.
news.head: Ravens D/ST allows 31 points in Week 3 win
news.impact: Baltimore's defense struggled to keep up with an excellent Dallas offense in this high-scoring matchup. They managed to recover one fumble while getting a sack from Roquan Smith in the win. They will be a top fantasy option in Week 4 against the Titans.

news.body: The Ravens D/ST allowed 24 pints, 252 yards passing, and 65 rushing yards in the loss to the Saints.
news.head: Ravens D/ST struggles in Week 2 loss
news.impact: The Ravens' defense tallied three sacks but failed to force a turnover in the loss. The Ravens will need to get some of the issues with the pass defense together before taking on Dak Prescott and the Cowboys in Week 3.

news.body: The Ravens D/ST recorded two sacks, one fumble recovery, and one interception in a Week 1 win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Ravens D/ST stifles Colts in Week 1 win
news.impact: The defense stood tall in the season opener for first-year head coach Jesse Minter, allowing less than 275 offensive yards in the win. The unit will look to take advantage of a favorable Week 2 contest against the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: The Baltimore Ravens are hiring former Los Angeles Chargers DC Jesse Minter as their new head coach.
news.head: Baltimore Ravens hire Jesse Minter as Head Coach
news.impact: It was reported Minter turned down the Browns second interview as he saw better opportunity elsewhere, and this certainly fits the bill. He’ll look to take over the mantle of John Harbaugh and get the Ravens back into the playoff race in 2026 with Lamar Jackson at the helm of the offense and a talented defense to boot.

news.body: The Bills D/ST registered two sacks while also forcing one turnover (one interception) in a 24-16 win over the Los Angeles Chargers in Week 3.
news.head: Bills D/ST quiet in Week 3
news.impact: The defense made up for a surprising five giveaways by their offense, allowing just one touchdown in a winning effort. The unit will look to take advantage of a New England Patriots offense with turnover issues of their own in Week 4.

news.body: The Bills' D/ST logged four sacks and allowed 31 points in Thursday night's win over the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Bills D/ST allows 31 points in win Thursday
news.impact: Buffalo's defense looked good at the start of the game on Thursday night, but they weren't able to sustain that energy throughout and ended up allowing 31 points over the course of the night. This unit has some talent but will have a tough schedule coming up for the next three weeks at least, so fantasy managers shouldn't put much trust in them at this point in the season.

news.body: The Buffalo Bills D/ST had two fumble recoveries and three sacks against the Texans on Sunday in their 36-31 win.
news.head: Buffalo Bills D/ST comes up big in win over Houston
news.impact: Buffalo had a “bend, don’t break” sort of game against Houston, especially in the final minutes. The Texans had worked their way down the field to try for a potential game winning touchdown, but a strip sack on Houston QB CJ Stroud sealed the deal for the Bills. Overall their performance was fine given the turnovers they forced, but not spectacular given the points given up. They’ll face the Lions high powered offense on Thursday.

news.body: The Buffalo Bills are promoting former OC Joe Brady to be their new Head Coach.
news.head: Buffalo Bills promoting Joe Brady to Head Coach
news.impact: While the signing of Brady of course keeps some familiarity and continuity on the team, it’s a mixed bag for those who wanted something new in Buffalo. The offense has been fine thanks to the play of Josh Allen, but lacking in explosive plays from the receiver and tight end departments which have really held back the Bills in recent years. Maybe things change with a new sheriff in town.

news.body: The Bears D/ST allowed seven points while forcing three turnovers and notching two sacks in a 27-7 win over the Eagles in Week 3.
news.head: Bears D/ST excellent in Week 3 win
news.impact: Chicago's defense came to play in Week 3's Monday night game. They made things tough on the Philly offense, intercepting two passes and recovering a Tank Bigsby fumble. They will look to keep it going in Week 4 against the Jets.

news.body: The Bears D/ST recorded three sacks in a 9-3 loss to the Chicago Bears in Week 2.
news.head: Bears D/ST steady in Week 2 loss
news.impact: The unit made up for a lackluster performance from the offense, allowing just 246 offensive yards in a losing effort. The defense will look for another strong performance against the Philadelphia Eagles in Week 3.

news.body: The Bears D/ST forced two turnovers (one interception, one fumble recovery) while also registering two sacks in a 59-37 win over the Carolina Panthers in Week 1.
news.head: Bears D/ST torched through air in Week 1
news.impact: The unit struggled to stop the Carolina offense through the air, allowing over 350 passing yards and three passing touchdowns in the win. The unit will look to get back on track in a Week 2 divisional contest against the Minnesota Vikings.

news.body: The Chicago Bears D/ST recorded three sacks and had an interception on Sunday, but did allow 433 yards of total offense in the 19-16 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Chicago Bears D/ST relatively quiet in Week 18
news.impact: The Bears defense has allowed 384, 496, and 433 yards over the last three weeks, but they have registered at least one turnover in 10 consecutive games. Chicago gets Green Bay at home in the opening round of the playoffs.

news.body: The Browns' D/ST logged three sacks and an interception while allowing 18 points in Sunday's win over the Carolina Panthers.
news.head: Browns D/ST plays well in win Sunday
news.impact: Cleveland's defense did well on Sunday, holding Carolina's offense to just 18 points over the course of the afternoon. They were also able to log several big plays to help out the offense, which played a big hand in their eventual win.

news.body: The Browns D/ST allowed 19 points on 313 total yards with one interception and three sacks on Sunday against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Browns D/ST keeps Buccaneers offense in check
news.impact: The Browns defense was able to help lead the team to an upset win over Tampa Bay. They'll face Bryce Young and the Panthers next week.

news.body: The Cleveland Browns D/ST was outmatched in the team's 34-10 loss to the Jaguars, achieving just one sack in the blowout loss.
news.head: Cleveland Browns D/ST outmatched in loss to Jaguars
news.impact: It was a rough showing for the Browns, who were hoping that their defense would at least have some semblance of its form from last year. At least in Week 1, that was not the case in the slightest. They're firmly out of streaming consideration unless it's the best of matchups.

news.body: The Cleveland Browns hired Todd Monken as their next head coach.
news.head: Browns hire Todd Monken as next head coach
news.impact: The former Ravens offensive coordinator remains in the AFC North. Monken had been rumored to potentially follow John Harbaugh to the Giants as their offensive coordinator, but he instead lands his own head coaching job. Monken was previously the Browns offensive coordinator in 2019. He'll look to help transform the Browns offense that showed some flashes this past year.

news.body: The Broncos' D/ST logged four sacks, two interceptions, and a touchdown while allowing 26 points in Sunday night's win over the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Broncos D/ST scores touchdown in win Sunday
news.impact: Denver's defense allowed the Rams' offense to move the ball on Sunday night, but they logged several big plays to help change the course of the game, including a pick-six at one crucial point. This unit is one of the NFL's finest but will have their work cut out for them in a matchup against San Francisco's red-hot offense in Week 4.

news.body: The Broncos D/ST allowed 13 points while notching two sacks and forcing one turnover in a 20-13 win over the Jaguars in Week 2.
news.head: Broncos D/ST holds Jags to 13 points
news.impact: Denver's defense made life difficult for the Jacksonville offense, holding them to just three points after halftime. It was a needed bounce-back performance after the Broncos struggled on defense against the Chiefs in Week 1. They will look to keep it going in Week 3 against the Rams.

news.body: The Broncos' D/ST logged two sacks and one interception while allowing 31 points in Monday night's blowout loss to the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Broncos D/ST dismal in loss Monday
news.impact: Denver's defense is supposed to be among the best in the entire NFL, but they didn't look the part on Monday night. They allowed Patrick Mahomes II to lead Kansas City to 31 points on the night, despite the fact that this was his first game back from a major injury and was missing one of his starting tackles. This unit should return to elite form at some point this season, but they have a rocky schedule coming up for the next 4-6 weeks and should not be considered an elite fantasy option at the position for that stretch of games.

news.body: The Broncos' D/ST logged four sacks, one interception, one fumble recovery, and a touchdown while allowing just three points in Sunday's win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Broncos D/ST scores touchdown in Week 18 win
news.impact: Denver's defense has been among the best in the league all season long, and they had a suitable performance to end the regular season on Sunday. They logged four sacks and two turnovers against the Chargers, one of which they were able to take to the house for a touchdown. This unit will make life hard for any team they end up playing in the postseason.

news.body: The Lions D/ST allowed 24 points, 321 passing yards, and 58 rushing yards in a 31-24 win over the Jets.
news.head: Lions D/ST allows 24 points in Week 3 win
news.impact: The Lions' defense tallied five sacks and forced a fumble from Geno Smith to seal the game late in the fourth quarter. The defense struggled against the pass, allowing an average of 8.7 yards per completion. The Lions will head to Carolina to take on the Panthers in Week 4.

news.body: The Lions' D/ST logged two sacks and allowed 41 points in Thursday night's loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Lions D/ST dismal in loss Thursday
news.impact: Detroit's defense looked terrible on Thursday night. They allowed Buffalo's offense to move the ball at will and gave up 41 points over the course of the night, which led to a loss for the team. They also looked poor against the Saints in Week 1, so this is shaping up to be a bad unit for the Lions, although we may get to see a better side to them with an easy schedule coming up over the next few weeks.

news.body: The Lions D/ST forced three turnovers (two interceptions, one fumble recovery) while also picking up five sacks in a 31-30 Week 1 win over the New Orleans Saints.
news.head: Lions D/ST stands tall in Week 1 win
news.impact: The unit escaped after allowing the Saints to come back from a 21-0 deficit in the second half, with New Orleans quarterback Tyler Shough overthrowing a potential game-winning two-point conversion in overtime. Fantasy managers will need to have another option available with a Week 2 matchup against the Buffalo Bills up next.

news.body: The Detroit Lions D/ST recorded just one sack and had one interception during the team's 19-16 win over the Bears in the last game of the year.
news.head: Detroit Lions D/ST quiet in season finale
news.impact: The Lions allowed only 270 yards of total offense to the Bears, marking the sixth-lowest total they have allowed in a game all season. However, they had trouble getting to Caleb Williams, sacking the quarterback just once. Avonte Maddox had the interception which led to a Lions' field goal late in the third quarter.

news.body: The Green Bay Packers D/ST managed an early interception before going quiet on the box score for the rest of the game in the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons.
news.head: Green Bay Packers D/ST run over by Atlanta in loss
news.impact: The Packers pulled off a pick four plays into the game, but didn't put anything else on the stat sheet afterwards. It was a dominant outing by the Falcons offense, with the Packers defense unable to stop Drake London or the ground game led by Bijan and Brian Robinson, who collectively averaged 5.9 yards per carry on the night. They'll look to be better next time out.

news.body: The Packers D/ST recorded four sacks in a 20-17 win over the New York Jets in Week 2.
news.head: Packers D/ST picks up four sacks in Week 2 win
news.impact: The unit made stops when it mattered to carry an inconsistent Green Bay offense, allowing 285 offensive yards in the win. The defense will look to take advantage of an underwhelming Atlanta Falcons offense in Week 3.

news.body: The Packers D/ST allowed 39 points on 239 total yards with three sacks and one interception.
news.head: Packers D/ST totals three sacks Sunday
news.impact: Green Bay held its own early despite still being without Micah Parsons. The Packers draw Geno Smith and the Jets next week.

news.body: The Green Bay Packers are hiring Jonathan Gannon as their new Defensive Coordinator.
news.head: Green Bay Packers hire Jonathan Gannon as DC
news.impact: Gannon was fired after an unsuccessful head coaching tenure in Arizona, but he lands in Green Bay with a promising unit led by Micah Parsons, who looks to return from injury during the middle of the 2026 season if not sooner.

news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 19 points, 235 passing yards, and 89 rushing yards in a loss to the Colts Sunday.
news.head: Texans D/ST allows 19 points in Week 3
news.impact: Houston's defense did a great job of keeping Jonathan Taylor in check, but allowed Daniel Jones to perform well enough to send the Texans to 0-3. The Texans will face Dallas in a tough matchup in Week 4.

news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 20 points on 267 total yards with five sacks on Sunday against the Bengals.
news.head: Texans D/ST totals five sacks Sunday
news.impact: Houston was able to get pressure on Joe Burrow all afternoon, but Ja'Marr Chase burned them for a pair of touchdowns. They will face Daniel Jones and the Colts next week.

news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 36 points on 409 yards of total offense while coming up with two sacks and no takeaways in Sunday's loss to the Bills.
news.head: Texans defense struggles to contain Bills in Week 1
news.impact: The Texans should feature a solid defensive unit this season, but they ran into a potent Bills' offense in Week 1. Powered by QB Josh Allen, the Bills shredded the Texans' pass defense, totaling 334 yards and a couple of scores through the air. Houston did come up with a couple of sacks, but Allen mostly had his way. The Texans will face another top-tier QB when Joe Burrow and the Bengals visit Houston in Week 2.

news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 30 points on 354 total yards with one interception, one sack and fumble recoveries on Sunday against the Colts.
news.head: Texans D/ST recovers two fumbles in Week 18
news.impact: Houston sat its starters in the second half. They remain one of the top defenses in the NFL. They'll take on Aaron Rodgers and the Steelers in the Wild Card round.

news.body: The Chiefs D/ST recorded four sacks while also forcing two turnovers (one interception, one fumble recovery) in a 24-10 win over the Miami Dolphins in Week 3.
news.head: Chiefs D/ST records four sacks in Week 3
news.impact: The defense made stops when it needed to, allowing just one touchdown despite giving up 329 offensive yards in the win. The unit will look for more impactful plays against the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 4.

news.body: The Chiefs' D/ST logged one interception and allowed 30 points in Sunday night's overtime win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Chiefs D/ST struggles in win Sunday
news.impact: Kansas City's defense didn't look good on Sunday night. They allowed Indianapolis to put up 30 points, and they weren't able to log a single sack or turnover beyond one interception. This unit should bounce back and look great in matchups against the Dolphins and Raiders over the next two weeks.

news.body: The Chiefs' D/ST logged four sacks and one interception while allowing just ten points in Monday night's win over the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Chiefs D/ST stellar in win Monday
news.impact: Kansas City was able to pick up a great win over their divisional rivals on Monday night. The performance of their defense had a lot to do with that, as they held Bo Nix and Co. to just ten points on the night and made numerous big plays to help out their offense. This is one of the league's best units at this point, and they will enjoy one of the league's easiest schedules over the next three weeks. They should be a waiver target in any league they are not currently rostered in.

news.body: The Chiefs D/ST allowed 105 passing yards, 118 rushing yards, and 14 points in the 14-12 loss to the Raiders.
news.head: Chiefs D/ST allows 14 points in Week 18
news.impact: The Chiefs' defense tallied three sacks, one interception, and one fumble recovery in the win. Despite a strong effort from the defense, the offense was unable to get enough points on the board to end the 2025 season with a win.

news.body: The Rams' D/ST logged one sack and one interception while allowing 24 points in Sunday night's loss to the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Rams D/ST underwhelming in loss Sunday
news.impact: Los Angeles' defense was underwhelming on Sunday night. They weren't able to log many big plays over the course of the night, and they allowed Denver's offense to score 24 points in primetime. This unit has a tough schedule coming up, which makes it hard to get excited for them from a fantasy standpoint.

news.body: The Rams' D/ST logged two sacks and an interception while allowing just six points in Monday night's blowout win over the New York Giants.
news.head: Rams D/ST plays well in win Monday
news.impact: Los Angeles' defense looked good on Monday night. They held the Giants' offense to just six points on the night, but that was also aided by the multiple key injuries that New York suffered over the course of the night. This unit can be started in a matchup against the Broncos next week, although that is by no means an easy game for them.

news.body: The Los Angeles Rams' D/ST was completely destroyed by the 49ers' offense, and it didn't help that the Rams' offense was equally outmatched, making the final result all the more stark.
news.head: Los Angeles Rams D/ST run over by 49ers
news.impact: The Rams still have plenty of star talent on this side of the ball, so don't overreact to one week of football. They should be just fine as the season rolls along once they find their footing.

news.body: The Rams D/ST allowed 238 passing yards, 79 rushing yards, and 20 points in a 37-20 win over the Cardinals.
news.head: Rams D/ST allows 20 points in Week 18 win
news.impact: The Rams' defense tallied one interception, one fumble, and six sacks in the win. The Rams will head on the road to take on the NFC South champion Carolina Panthers in the first round of the playoffs.

news.body: The Vikings D/ST allowed 16 points on 243 total yards with six sacks and two interceptions on Sunday against the Bucs.
news.head: Vikings D/ST dominates in win Sunday
news.impact: The Vikings D/ST also scored a touchdown on a punt return. Minnesota needed its defense to come through as the offense struggled for most of the afternoon. They will be a top play next week against the Dolphins.

news.body: The Vikings D/ST registered four sacks while also forcing two turnovers (one interception, one fumble recovery) in a 9-3 win over the Chicago Bears in Week 2.
news.head: Vikings D/ST disruptive in Week 2
news.impact: The unit was able to stand tall against a Chicago ground attack, holding both D’Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai to less than 50 yards rushing each. The defense will look to take advantage of a turnover-prone Tampa Bay Buccaneers offense in Week 3.

news.body: The Vikings D/ST allowed 22 points on 419 total yards with one interception, one fumble recovery and four sacks on Sunday against the Packers.
news.head: Vikings D/ST picks it up late Sunday
news.impact: Minnesota struggled in the first half defensively, but limited Green Bay to just three points in the second half where they out-scored the Packers 29-3. They'll be tough to trust next week against the Bears.

news.body: The Minnesota Vikings D/ST allowed only 121 yards of total offense and sacked Green Bay quarterback Clayton Tune four times en route to a 16-3 win over the Packers on Sunday.
news.head: Minnesota Vikings D/ST shuts down Packers in Week 18
news.impact: Green Bay rested most of its starters on Sunday as it entered the game locked into the #7 seed in the NFC. However, take nothing away from the Vikings, who allowed -7 net passing yards on the afternoon. Minnesota finished with four sacks - two by Dallas Turner - and also had eight tackles for a loss.

news.body: The Saints D/ST allowed 35 points on 381 total yards with three sacks and a fumble recovery on Sunday against the Raiders.
news.head: Saints D/ST recovers fumble Sunday
news.impact: The Saints were unable to force any interceptions on Kirk Cousins. It did not help that the Saints offense turned the ball over four times in the final quarter. They'll face Bijan Robinson and the Falcons next week.

news.body: The Saints D/ST allowed 17 points, 235 passing yards, and 108 rushing yards in a 24-17 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Saints D/ST allows 17 points in Week 2 win
news.impact: The Saints D/ST tallied three sacks and one interception in the upset win over the Ravens. The interception was on the Ravens' last offensive play to seal the win for the Saints. New Orleans will take on the Raiders in Week 3.

news.body: The Saints D/ST forced one turnover (one fumble recovery) while also recording one sack in a 31-30 loss to the Detroit Lions in Week 1.
news.head: Saints D/ST quiet in Week 1
news.impact: The unit struggled to contain dynamic running back Jahmyr Gibbs, allowing 5.4 yards per carry to the electric running back. The defense faces another tough rushing attack from the Baltimore Ravens in Week 2.

news.body: The Saints D/ST allowed 19 points on 208 total yards with four sacks and one interception on Sunday against the Falcons.
news.head: Saints D/ST allows 19 points in Week 18
news.impact: The Saints D/ST finished the year strong as a unit. They could hold some more streaming appeal in favorable matchups heading into next season.

news.body: The Giants' D/ST logged one interception and one fumble recovery while allowing seven points in Sunday's win over the Tennessee Titans.
news.head: Giants D/ST forces two turnovers Sunday
news.impact: New York's defense held the Titans to just seven points on Sunday, which ultimately led to the Giants escaping with a win despite scoring just 12 points themselves. This unit lost Brian Burns (knee) in the process, however, as he is likely to miss the rest of the season with what is suspected to be a torn ACL. His absence will significantly hurt their defensive front and pass rush moving forward.

news.body: The Giants' D/ST logged one sack, one interception, and one fumble recovery while allowing 28 points in Monday night's loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Giants D/ST allows 28 points in loss Monday
news.impact: New York's defense struggled on Monday night. They allowed 28 points over the course of the game, despite actually forcing a couple turnovers to help their offense out. This unit should not be started moving forward, even with a relatively easy schedule coming down the pipe for them.

news.body: The Giants' D/ST logged one interception and allowed 20 points in Sunday night's win over the Dallas Cowboys.
news.head: Giants D/ST allows 20 points Sunday
news.impact: New York's defense helped lead the team to a win on Sunday night. They held Dallas' talented offense to just 20 points over the course of the night and logged takeaway to help out the offense. They were held without a sack all game, however, so their pass rush will likely need to improve if they want to continue winning games moving forward.

news.body: The New York Giants are finalizing a deal to sign John Harbaugh as their next head coach.
news.head: New York Giants finalizing deal with John Harbaugh
news.impact: Harbaugh was the Ravens' long-time head coach and found plenty of success in Baltimore. As the man in charge, he had a record of 180-113 and won a Super Bowl. He would team up with quarterback Jaxson Dart to bring the Giants back to the postseason, though the deal is not yet finalized.

news.body: The Jets D/ST allowed 31 points, 269 passing yards, and 131 rushing yards in a 31-24 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Jets D/ST allows 31 points in Week 3 loss
news.impact: The Jets' defense tallied two sacks of Jared Goff, but failed to force a turnover in the loss. They may have an easier matchup in Week 4 with Caleb Williams (hamstring) unlikely to play for the Bears.

news.body: The Jets D/ST registered three sacks while also forcing one turnover (one fumble recovery) in a 20-17 loss to the Green Bay Packers in Week 2.
news.head: Jets D/ST registers three sacks in Week 2
news.impact: The unit was mostly solid outside of a fourth quarter letdown for head coach Aaron Glenn, allowing under 200 offensive yards in a losing effort. The defense will be difficult to trust against a high-powered Detroit Lions offense in Week 3.

news.body: The Jets D/ST allowed 10 points while forcing one turnover and notching three sacks in a 23-10 win over the Titans in Week 1.
news.head: Jets D/ST holds Titans to 10 points
news.impact: The Jets' defenders made it a difficult afternoon for Cam Ward and company in the season opener. They recovered a Chimere Dike for their turnover while Kingsley Enagbare, Will McDonald IV, and David Bailey each had a sack. Things will be much tougher for this unit in Week 2 against the Packers.

news.body: The Jets D/ST allowed 259 passing yards, 211 rushing yards, and 35 points in a 35-8 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Jets D/ST allows 35 points in Week 18 loss
news.impact: The Jets' defense failed to record a sack or a turnover in the loss. The Jets' defense did set a record Sunday, as they are the first team to finish a season without an interception in NFL history.

news.body: The Eagles D/ST allowed 27 points while failing to record a sack or force any turnovers in a 27-7 loss to the Bears in Week 3.
news.head: Eagles D/ST allows 27 points in Week 3
news.impact: It was a poor performance by the Eagles on Monday night as they couldn't stop Case Keenum from carving them up. Keenum hadn't appeared in a regular-season game since 2023, but he tossed two touchdowns and ran for a third. The Eagles will look to regroup in a tough Week 4 matchup against the Rams.

news.body: The Eagles D/ST allowed 20 points while adding two sacks in a 24-20 win over the Titans in Week 2.
news.head: Eagles D/ST picks up two sacks in Week 2
news.impact: Philadelphia held Tennessee to 291 yards of total offense but they needed a last-minute TD pass from Jalen Hurts to avoid the upset. The Eagles will now head on the road to take on a Bears offense that could be without Caleb Williams (hamstring) in Week 3.

news.body: The Eagles D/ST registered one sack while failing to force any turnovers in a 24-22 win over the Washington Commanders in Week 1.
news.head: Eagles D/ST registers one sack in Week 1
news.impact: The unit left plenty to be desired in the season-opening win, allowing 296 offensive yards and three touchdowns on the day. The defense will look for more disruptive results for fantasy managers against an underwhelming Tennessee Titans offense in Week 2.

news.body: The Eagles D/ST allowed 24 points while forcing two turnovers in a 24-17 loss to the Commanders in Week 18.
news.head: Eagles D/ST forces two turnovers in Week 18
news.impact: Philadelphia's defense struggled to contain Washington's offense in the loss, although they did manage one interception and recovered one fumble. They will now prepare to face the 49ers at home in the Wild-Card round next week.

news.body: The Steelers D/ST allowed 27 points, 282 passing yards, and 83 rushing yards in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
news.head: Steelers D/ST allows 27 points in Week 3 win
news.impact: The Steelers' defense tallied one sack and one fumble recovery in the win Sunday. The fumble recovery came on the final drive for the Bengals to help seal the win for the Steelers. The defense will now prepare for the Browns in Week 4.

news.body: The Steelers D/ST allowed 14 points, 208 passing yards, and 136 rushing yards in the 20-3 loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Steelers D/ST allows 14 points in Week 2 loss
news.impact: The Steelers' defense did tally an interception, a fumble recovery, and three sacks in the losing effort Sunday. The Steelers' defense will be at home against a strong Bengals' offense in Week 3.

news.body: The Steelers D/ST allowed 13 points while scoring a touchdown, forcing two turnovers, and notching four sacks in a 20-13 win over the Falcons in Week 1.
news.head: Steelers D/ST scores TD in Week 1 win
news.impact: Pittsburgh took advantage of the Falcons being forced to start their third-string QB in Cooper Rush. T.J. Watt dominated the whole afternoon as he sealed the game with a 35-yard pick-six in the fourth quarter while also logging two sacks. The Steelers will have a tougher test in Week 2 against the Patriots.

news.body: The Pittsburgh Steelers are working on a deal to sign Mike McCarthy as the organization's next head coach.
news.head: Steelers hiring Mike McCarthy as head coach
news.impact: McCarthy will succeed Mike Tomlin as the head man for the Steelers. Like Tomlin, McCarthy is one of the winningest coaches in NFL history, with a career record of 60.8% and 174 wins (15th). The Steelers value stability, and McCarthy brings that, along with ties to the city.

news.body: The Seahawks D/ST recorded two sacks while failing to force any turnovers in a 33-31 loss to the Washington Commanders in Week 3.
news.head: Seahawks D/ST quiet in Week 3
news.impact: The unit fell victim to a Seattle offense that turned the ball over three times in the loss. The defense will look to get back to its aggressive scheme in a Week 4 matchup against the Los Angeles Chargers.

news.body: The Seattle Seahawks D/ST shut down the Arizona Cardinals offense on Sunday 31-7, racking up an interception and two sacks in the big win.
news.head: Seattle Seahawks D/ST shuts down Cardinals defense on Sunday
news.impact: Seattle's defense has allowed a grand total of 17 points over two weeks. They're shaping up to be a formidable unit so far, and are a top defense to roster for fantasy moving forward.

news.body: The Seahawks' D/ST logged three sacks and three interceptions while allowing just ten points in Wednesday night's win over the New England Patriots.
news.head: Seahawks D/ST stellar in win Wednesday
news.impact: Seattle's defense put up a fantastic showing on Wednesday night. They not only held New England's strong offense to just ten points on the night, but they also recorded three interceptions, including one on the final drive of the game to seal the win. This unit is expected to be elite over the course of the season, assuming all of their key players remain healthy and on the field.

news.body: The Seattle Seahawks D/ST held the high-powered 49ers offense to just 173 total yards on Saturday night as Seattle clinched the NFC West and the top seed in the NFC with a 13-3 victory.
news.head: Seattle Seahawks D/ST shuts down 49ers offense Saturday
news.impact: The Seahawks' defense was swarming all night, limiting the 49ers to just nine first downs and 173 total yards for the game. Seattle sacked Brock Purdy three times and also got a huge interception from Drake Thomas at the Seahawks' three-yard line early in the fourth quarter. San Francisco was 2-of-9 on third downs and averaged only 4.1 yards per play on the night.

news.body: The 49ers D/ST allowed 30 points on 365 total yards with two sacks on Sunday against the Cardinals.
news.head: 49ers D/ST struggles late Sunday
news.impact: San Francisco allowed just six points in the first half before allowing 24 points in the second half. They'll face Bo Nix and the Broncos next week.

news.body: The 49ers' defense allowed just 13 points on 284 yards of offense while recording four sacks in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: 49ers D/ST records four sacks, stifles Dolphins offense
news.impact: For the second straight week, the 49ers' defense dominated. The unit has surrendered just 20 points in two games, holding both the Rams and Dolphins under 300 yards of total offense. The 49ers will remain a popular play in Week 3 against the Cardinals.

news.body: The San Fransisco 49ers D/ST shut down the Rams offense on Thursday, allowing just seven points in their 27-7 rout of the Super Bowl favorites.
news.head: San Fransisco 49ers D/ST shuts down Rams in win
news.impact: The Niners defensive totals were modest, with one interception and a fumble recovery, but were held without a sack. They just kept the Rams from moving the ball while not racking up much in the “counting stats” category. It’s a good showing for the team, and a date with the Dolphins is on tap. They are a great DST option this week if available.

news.body: The San Francisco 49ers D/ST could muster only two sacks and did not force a turnover during their 13-3 loss to Seattle on Saturday night.
news.head: San Francisco 49ers D/ST does nothing of note Saturday
news.impact: Yes, the 49ers only gave up 13 points. But, it could have been much worse as Jason Myers missed two field goals and the Seahawks failed to convert on fourth-and-goal on the game's first drive. Seattle had 361 net yards, including 180 on the ground, and did not turn the ball over against the 49ers defense. That's two straight weeks - and three of the last four - that San Francisco has not forced a turnover.

news.body: The Buccaneers D/ST allowed 23 points on 230 total yards with an interception and three sacks on Sunday against the Vikings.
news.head: Buccaneers D/ST records interception Sunday
news.impact: The Bucs defense did everything they could to keep the team in the game. They'll face Jordan Love and the Packers next week.

news.body: The Buccaneers D/ST allowed 23 points on 267 total yards with two sacks.
news.head: Buccaneers D/ST allows 23 points Sunday
news.impact: It was a prime matchup for Tampa Bay against Deshaun Watson and the Browns offense and they failed to come through. They draw the Vikings next week.

news.body: The Buccaneers D/ST allowed 26 points on 351 total yards with one interception and one sack on Sunday against the Bengals.
news.head: Buccaneers D/ST put in tough spot Sunday
news.impact: Cincinnati scored 33 points, but one of them was off a fumble by Baker Mayfield returned for a touchdown. The Bengals also scored 17 other points off Bucs fumbles. The Bucs will be on the streaming radar in Week 2 against the Browns.

news.body: The Buccaneers D/ST allowed 14 points on 285 total yards with one interception and two fumble recoveries in Week 18 against the Panthers.
news.head: Buccaneers D/ST recovers two fumbles in Week 18
news.impact: While the Bucs secondary struggled most of the season, they held their own to close the season while also completely shutting down the Panthers rushing attack. The Bucs also recovered a pair of fumbles and added an interception.

news.body: Brandon Aubrey made three of his four field-goal attempts and added two extra points in a 34-31 loss to the Ravens in Brazil in Week 3.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey makes three FGs in Week 3
news.impact: Aubrey made field goals from 28, 38, and 23 yards out in the close loss to Baltimore. The veteran kicker has now hit six of his seven field-goal tries and added eight extra points this year. He will take on the Texans in Week 4.

news.body: Brandon Aubrey connected on all three field goal attempts and all four of his extra point attempts in a win over the Commanders.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey perfect in Week 2 win
news.impact: Aubrey connected on field goals from 25, 44, and 60 yards out to help pace the Cowboys to their first win over the season. Aubrey remains one of the best kickers in the league and is a strong start against Baltimore in Week 3.

news.body: Brandon Aubrey went 2-for-3 on his extra-point attempts in Sunday night's 28-20 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey misses one kick Sunday
news.impact: Aubrey didn't have a good night on Sunday night. He scored just two points in the team's loss to New York, and he even missed one of his extra-point attempts late in the game. He should bounce back and return to being a good fantasy option sometime in the near future.

news.body: The Cowboys signed K Brandon Aubrey to a four-year, $28 million contract extension.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey signs four-year extension with Cowboys
news.impact: Aubrey becomes the first kicker to ever earn $7 million per year and receive $20 million guaranteed. He has established himself as the top kicker in the NFL.

news.body: Cam Little made all five of his extra-point attempts and missed his lone field-goal attempt from 70 yards out in Sunday's 35-6 win over the New England Patriots.
news.head: Cam Little totals five points in win Sunday
news.impact: Little ended up with just five points on Sunday, which is a little disappointing considering how easily scoring came to the Jaguars against New England. He also barely missed one kick from what would have been an NFL record 70-yards out, which further hurt his fantasy total in this matchup. He should bounce back in the near future.

news.body: Cam Little made two of his three field goals and added an extra point in a 20-13 loss to the Broncos in Week 2.
news.head: Cam Little makes two FGs in Week 2
news.impact: Little hit field goals from 44 and 23 yards out in the game. The veteran kicker has hit four of his five field goals while going a perfect 5-for-5 on extra points through two games. He will take on the Patriots in Week 3.

news.body: Cam Little made both of his field goal attempts and all four of his PATs in the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns on Sunday.
news.head: Cam Little has nice day against Browns
news.impact: Little should be a nice kicker for those in need of one, or for those who have him, thanks to the firepower the Jags offense possesses. He will look to keep up his success next week against Denver.

news.body: Cam Little made all five of his PATs and both of his field goal attempts in the Jaguars' 41-7 win over the Titans.
news.head: Cam Little racks up 11 kicking points in win
news.impact: Little had a great game with the Jaguars putting up a scoring onslaught against the Titans. He's now put up 10+ kicking points in each of his last five games.

news.body: Cameron Dicker converted 3-of-4 field goal attempts while also making his lone extra point attempt to finish with 10 points in the Chargers' 24-16 loss to the Buffalo Bills in Week 3.
news.head: Cameron Dicker misses field goal in Week 3
news.impact: Dicker made the most of increased opportunities for head coach Jim Harbaugh, finishing with more than two points for the first time in three contests. The kicker has fallen victim to kicking behind an underwhelming Chargers offense to begin the season, with a Week 4 contest against the Seattle Seahawks up next.

news.body: Cameron Dicker went 2-for-2 on his extra-point attempts but missed his lone field-goal attempt in Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Cameron Dicker misses kick in loss Sunday
news.impact: The Chargers didn't have much going for them on Sunday, including kicking. Dicker misses his lone field-goal against the Raiders, leaving three more points on the field for Los Angeles. Fantasy managers of the 26-year old should consider moving to a different fantasy option for the time being.

news.body: Cameron Dicker did not attempt a field goal and made 2-of-2 PATs in Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Cardinals.
news.head: Cameron Dicker puts just two points on the board in Week 1
news.impact: Widely viewed as one of the best fantasy options among kickers, Dicker was not given much of an opportunity to contribute on Sunday. The Chargers drastically underperformed expectations, totaling only 268 yards of offense and being dominated in time of possession. Dicker will have better games, but this one was a huge disappointment for fantasy managers.

news.body: Cameron Dicker made his lone field-goal attempt in Sunday's 19-3 loss to the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Cameron Dicker makes lone kick Sunday
news.impact: Dicker was only given one opportunity on Sunday, but he was able to make it and finished with three points in the team's loss to the Broncos. That capped off what was another fantastic season for him, finishing as a top-four kicker in most fantasy league formats and distinguishing himself as one of the league's most consistent kickers in real life.

news.body: Chase McLaughlin connected on 3-of-3 field goals and his lone extra point on Sunday.
news.head: Chase McLaughlin makes three field goals Sunday
news.impact: McLaughlin connected on field goals from 28 yards, 38 and 54 yards out. He remains a steady option for fantasy managers week-to-week.

news.body: Chase McLaughlin connected on 4-of-4 field goal attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Chase McLaughlin makes four field goals Sunday
news.impact: McLaughlin made field goals from 59, 45, 31 and 31 yards out. He'll remain a reliable option for fantasy managers.

news.body: Chase McLaughlin made 2-of-2 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Chase McLaughlin connects on five kicks Sunday
news.impact: McLaughlin connected on field goals from 34 and 51 yards out. He should remain a steady option for fantasy managers.

news.body: Chase McLaughlin made 3-of-4 field goals and his lone extra point in Week 18 against the Panthers.
news.head: Chase McLaughlin makes 3-of-4 field goals in Week 18
news.impact: McLaughlin had a field goal blocked late in the win. He finishes the season connecting on 32-of-38 field goals.

news.body: Chris Boswell connected on 3-of-3 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
news.head: Chris Boswell prefect in Week 3 win
news.impact: Boswell had a much needed bounce back performance after missing kicks in each of his first two games. The veteran made field goals from 33, 36, and 44 yards out to help pace the Steelers to a win. Boswell and the Steelers will take on the Browns in Week 4.

news.body: Chris Boswell connected on 1-of-2 field goals in the Steelers 20-3 loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Chris Boswell misses a FG attempt in Week 2 loss
news.impact: Boswell connected on a 56-yard field goal and missed from 57-yards out in the first quarter. There were reports prior to the game that Boswell was struggling with kicks in pregame warmups, but both his miss and connection were from 55+ yards. Boswell and the Steelers will take on the Bengals at home in Week 3.

news.body: Chris Boswell made two of his three field-goal tries while adding two extra points in a 20-13 win over the Falcons in Week 1.
news.head: Chris Boswell makes two FGs in Week 1
news.impact: Boswell made field goals from 43 and 28 yards out in the win. The veteran kicker will now get ready to take on the Patriots in Week 2.

news.body: The Steelers signed K Chris Boswell to a four-year, $28 million extension.
news.head: Chris Boswell signs four-year extension with Steelers
news.impact: Boswell will earn $7 million per year which puts him tied with Brandon Aubrey for the highest in league history at the position. The new deal keeps him under contract with the Steelers through 2030.

news.body: Daniel Carlson made 3-of-4 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Daniel Carlson misses extra point Sunday
news.impact: Carlson did not attempt a field goal. He is 4-of-5 on field goal attempts to start the season.

news.body: Daniel Carlson connected on all three of his field goal attempts and his lone extra point attempt in the Saints 24-17 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Daniel Carlson perfect in Week 2 win
news.impact: Carlson connected on field goals from 23, 47, and 51 yards out to help pace the Saints to their first win of the season. The Saints' offense appears to have improved based on their performances over the first two weeks of the season. Carlson should continue to receive plenty of opportunities heading into a Week 3 matchup with the Raiders.

news.body: Daniel Carlson converted all three of his extra point attempts as well as one of his two field goal attempts to finish with six points in the Saints' 31-30 loss to the Detroit Lions in Week 1.
news.head: Daniel Carlson misses field goal in Week 1
news.impact: Carlson was unable to convert on a 60-yard field goal on an otherwise solid season-opening performance. The kicker remains difficult to trust behind an inconsistent New Orleans offense, with a Week 2 contest against the Baltimore Ravens up next.

news.body: The Saints signed K Daniel Carlson.
news.head: Daniel Carlson signs with Saints
news.impact: Carlson will compete with Tanner Brown and Charlie Smyth for the starting kicker job for New Orleans.

news.body: Eddy Pineiro made his lone field goal and 3-of-5 extra points on Sunday.
news.head: Eddy Pineiro misses two extra points Sunday
news.impact: Pineiro made his lone field goal from 57 yards out. It was a rare off day for him kicking extra points.

news.body: Eddy Pineiro did not attempt a field goal but made all five of his PATs in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Eddy Pineiro makes five PATs in Sunday's win
news.impact: The 49ers found the end zone with each of their first five drives Sunday afternoon, and did not give Pineiro any field-goal chances. That's obviously not going to be the case each week. The veteran should be a solid fantasy option for a squad that looks really strong so far.

news.body: Eddy Pineiro (illness) will kick for the 49ers in Week 2's matchup with the Dolphins.
news.head: Eddy Pineiro (illness) ready to go for Sunday's game
news.impact: Pineiro has missed practice all week due to being under the weather, but the veteran kicker will be ready to go Sunday. Pineiro hit 2-of-3 field goals and all three of his PATs in Week 1.

news.body: Eddy Pineiro (illness) is uncertain to play in Sunday's game against the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Eddy Pineiro (illness) uncertain to play Sunday
news.impact: The veteran kicker is officially considered questionable to play heading into the weekend. He is dealing with a mildly serious illness right now that has left him sidelined from practice all week, and it's unclear whether or not he will be ready to go in time for the team's matchup against the Dolphins, which would make them need to determine who will take his place prior to kickoff.

news.body: Evan McPherson connected on 2-of-2 field goal attempts and all three extra point attempts in a 30-27 loss to the Steelers.
news.head: Evan McPherson perfect in Week 3
news.impact: McPherson continues to provide the Bengals with a steady leg on special teams, as he has yet to miss a kick so far this season. The 27-year-old will look to continue his strong start to the season against the Jaguars in Week 4.

news.body: Evan McPherson made both field goal and extra point attempts on Sunday against the Texans.
news.head: Evan McPherson connects on four kicks Sunday
news.impact: McPherson connected on field goals from 51 and 57 yards out. He remains fairly safe for fantasy managers week-to-week.

news.body: Evan McPherson made 4-of-4 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Evan McPherson connects on seven kicks Sunday
news.impact: McPherson connected on field goals from 20, 55, 58 and 32 yards out. He should remain a fairly reliable weekly play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Evan McPherson failed to hit either of his PATs in the Bengals' 20-18 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
news.head: Evan McPherson shut out in loss
news.impact: McPherson's failed PATs put the Bengals on the backfoot, forcing them to take a 2-PT conversion attempt that ultimately failed. He's been solid and actually finished with the best FGM % of his career. He should be a good bet for fantasy relevance next season.

news.body: Harrison Butker converted all three of his extra point attempts while missing 1-of-2 field goal attempts to finish with six points in the Chiefs' 24-10 win over the Miami Dolphins in Week 3.
news.head: Harrison Butker misses field goal in Week 3
news.impact: Butker continues a solid start to the season, recording six or more points in each of the first three contests. The kicker remains one of the more stable options in all formats behind a revamped Kansas City offense for head coach Andy Reid, with a Week 4 contest against the Las Vegas Raiders up next.

news.body: Harrison Butker went 4-for-5 on his field-goal attempts and 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts in Sunday night's 33-30 overtime win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Harrison Butker scores 15 points in OT win Sunday
news.impact: Butker missed one field goal on Sunday night, but outside of that, he was perfect. He made all seven of his other kicks, including a walk-off kick which secured the win for Kansas City in overtime. He should continue to be a good fantasy asset moving forward.

news.body: Harrison Butker went 4-for-4 on his extra-point attempts and made his lone field-goal attempt in Monday night's 31-10 win over the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Harrison Butker perfect in win Monday
news.impact: Butker did his job on Monday night, hitting all five of his kicks in the team's big win over the Broncos. He didn't end up with a good total from a fantasy perspective, but he should still be considered one of the better fantasy options at his position moving forward.

news.body: Harrison Butker connected on 4-of-4 field goals in the Chiefs 14-12 loss to the Raiders.
news.head: Harrison Butker perfect in Week 18 loss
news.impact: Butker connected on field goals from 36, 40, 41, and 47 to account for all of the scoring for the Chiefs Sunday. The veteran kicker remains under contract with the Chiefs for 2026 and should remain one of the top options at the position for fantasy managers.

news.body: Harrison Mevis went 4-for-4 on his field-goal attempts and made both of his extra-point attempts in Sunday night's 30-26 loss to the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Harrison Mevis scores 14 points in loss Sunday
news.impact: Mevis was a bright spot for the Rams on Sunday night. He knocked down all six of his kicks against the Broncos, leaving him with a total of 14 points on the night. He should continue to be a good fantasy option at the position moving forward.

news.body: Harrison Mevis went 4-for-4 on his extra-point attempts but missed his lone field-goal attempt in Monday night's 28-6 win over the New York Giants.
news.head: Harrison Mevis misses kick in win Monday
news.impact: Mevis missed a field goal late in Monday night's game, but luckily for him, it wasn't very consequential with Los Angeles already being up several scores. He should return to being a solid fantasy option at the position somewhat soon.

news.body: Harrison Mevis made his only PAT attempt in the Rams' 27-7 tough loss to the 49ers.
news.head: Harrison Mevis kicks single PAT in loss to Niners
news.impact: Mevis wasn't called upon much, the Rams offense was just never in scoring position for most of the game. He could have come in in the second half, but the Rams elected to go for it on 4th and goal at the 1 yard line, which was the correct choice, but their failure to convert meant Mevis was going to have an even bigger stinker. Brighter days are ahead for the Rams kicker.

news.body: Harrison Mevis has been tendered by the Rams and will return to Los Angeles for the 2026 season.
news.head: Harrison Mevis returns to Rams after being tendered Monday
news.impact: Undrafted out of Missouri in 2024, Mevis was a revelation for both the Rams and for fantasy owners last season. He replaced Joshua Karty as Los Angeles' kicker midway through they year and went 12-for-13 on field goal tries and a perfect 39-of-39 on extra point attempts in nine regular season games. He was also perfect in three postseason contests, going 6-for-6 on field goals and 9-for-9 on PATs. Mevis will open 2026 as the Rams' primary kicker and, given the potency of Los Angeles' offense, should be in line for a big year.

news.body: Jake Bates connected on his lone field goal attempt and all four of his extra point attempts in a 31-24 win over the Jets.
news.head: Jake Bates perfect in Week 3 win
news.impact: Bates was perfect after each touchdown and made his lone field goal from 30-yards out to open the scoring in the second quarter. Bates has yet to miss a kick this season and will take his perfect season on the road to Carolina in Week 4.

news.body: Jake Bates went 4-for-4 on his extra-point attempts and made his lone field-goal attempt in Thursday night's 41-31 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Jake Bates perfect in loss Thursday
news.impact: Bates did his job on Thursday night. He made all five of his kicks over the course of the game, so he carries no blame for Detroit's loss to the Bills. He should continue to be a quality fantasy asset at the position moving forward.

news.body: Jake Bates converted all four of his extra point attempts as well as his lone field goal attempt to finish with seven points in the Lions' 31-30 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 1.
news.head: Jake Bates picks up seven points in Week 1
news.impact: Bates made the most of his opportunities behind a Detroit offense that battled consistency issues in the season opener. The kicker should once again be in line for plenty of opportunities in what should be a high-scoring Week 2 matchup against the Buffalo Bills.

news.body: The Lions tendered exclusive rights free agent K Jake Bates.
news.head: Jake Bates tendered by Lions
news.impact: Bates took a slight step back last season, but he has still been a stable kicker for the Lions. He'll remain a strong option for fantasy managers next season.

news.body: Jason Myers converted his only field goal attempt as well as all four of his extra point attempts to finish with seven points in the Seahawks' 33-31 loss to the Washington Commanders in Week 3.
news.head: Jason Myers racks up seven points in Week 3
news.impact: Myers continues a strong start to the season, recording seven points in each of the first three contests. The kicker remains one of the more impactful options in related formats, with a Week 4 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers up next.

news.body: Jason Myers hit all four of his PATs and his lone field goal attempt in the Seahawks' 31-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.head: Jason Myers hits four PATs in win over Arizona
news.impact: Myers has had seven kicking points in each of his first two games, a solid total. He's going to continue to be productive thanks to the Seahawks offense being as potent as it is.

news.body: Jason Myers went 2-for-2 on his field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point attempt in Wednesday's 13-10 win over the New England Patriots.
news.head: Jason Myers scores seven points in win Wednesday
news.impact: Myers did his job on Wednesday, knocking in all three of his kicks en route to a win over the Patriots. He will likely be a decent fantasy option at the position over the course of the season, assuming QB Sam Darnold (hip) doesn't miss significant time and leave the offense weaker moving forward.

news.body: Jason Myers missed two field goal attempts on Saturday night but the Seahawks still managed a 13-3 win over San Francisco to clinch the top seed in the NFC.
news.head: Jason Myers has rare off night Saturday
news.impact: Myers had made 18 straight field goal attempts before his miss from 47 yards out early in the second quarter. He also missed on Seattle's last drive of the game when he hit the right upright from 26 yards away. Myers did have makes of 45 yards and 31 yards and also converted his only extra point attempt. Myers finishes with career highs in field goals made (41) and field goal attempts (48) while also converting a perfect 48-of-48 on PATs.

news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn connected on his lone field goal attempts and two extra point attempts in a 19-17 loss to the Colts.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn perfect in Week 3 loss
news.impact: Fairbairn made his lone field goal attempt for 24-yard outs in the fourth quarter. The 32-year-old has missed just one kick so far in the first three games. Houston will take on Dallas in Week 4.

news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn connected on 2-of-3 field goal attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn makes two field goals Sunday
news.impact: Fairbairn connected on field goals from 37 and 45 yards out. He missed from 58 yards out in the third quarter.

news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn made his only field-goal try and all four of his PATs in Sunday's 36-31 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn puts seven points on the board
news.impact: Fairbairn showed off his powerful leg in Sunday's loss, nailing a 58-yard attempt to briefly give the Texans a one-point lead in the fourth quarter. The veteran has been kicking for the Texans since 2017 and remains one of the more reliable options in the league.

news.body: The Texans re-signed K Ka'imi Fairbairn to a two-year, $13 million deal.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn re-signs with Texans
news.impact: Fairbairn will remain in Houston for two more years. He remains one of the top kickers in the NFL and for fantasy managers.

news.body: Matt Gay made 3-of-3 field goal attempts and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Matt Gay connects on five kicks Sunday
news.impact: Gay connected on field goals from 41, 37 and 25 yards out. He is 7-for-7 on field goal attempts through the first three games.

news.body: Matt Gay went 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts and made his lone field-goal attempt in Sunday's 26-14 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Matt Gay perfect in win Sunday
news.impact: The veteran kicker played well on Sunday, making all four of his attempted kicks in a win over the Chargers. He isn't expected to be a good fantasy option for the foreseeable future, however, with a tough schedule coming up for Las Vegas.

news.body: Matt Gay converted both of his field goal attempts as well as all three of his extra point attempts to finish with nine points in the Raiders' 27-13 win over the Miami Dolphins in Week 1.
news.head: Matt Gay racks up nine points in Week 1
news.impact: Gay took advantage of his opportunities despite a mixed performance from the Las Vegas offense in the season opener, converting all five of his kick attempts in the win. The kicker will look to remain a stable option moving forward, with a Week 2 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers up next.

news.body: The Raiders agreed to terms with K Matt Gay.
news.head: Matt Gay agrees to deal with Raiders
news.impact: Matt Gay kicked for both the Commanders and 49ers last season. He will take over the starting job for Daniel Carlson in Las Vegas.

news.body: Ryan Fitzgerald went four-of-four on his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 21-18 loss to the Cleveland Browns.
news.head: Ryan Fitzgerald totals 12 points in loss Sunday
news.impact: Fitzgerald looked good on Sunday. He made all four of his kicks against the Browns, including one from 53 yards out. He will likely continue to be a good but not great fantasy option moving forward.

news.body: Ryan Fitzgerald made both of his field goal attempts and all four of his PATs in the Panthers' 34-3 rout of the Falcons on Sunday.
news.head: Ryan Fitzgerald goes for 10 kicking points in win
news.impact: Fitzgerald had himself a nice day, making a couple of short field goals and capitalizing on the Panthers' many touchdowns on the day. The team has scored 37 and 34 points in their first two games, and Fitz seems like a good bet to continue to have success.

news.body: Ryan Fitzgerald converted his lone field goal attempt as well as four of his five extra point attempts to finish with seven points in the Panthers' 59-37 loss to the Chicago Bears in Week 1.
news.head: Ryan Fitzgerald misses extra point in Week 1
news.impact: Fitzgerald turned in a mostly solid performance, with the missed extra point the outlier. The kicker will look for more success in a Week 2 divisional contest against the Atlanta Falcons.

news.body: Ryan Fitzgerald made his two extra point attempts, but missed his lone field goal in Week 18 against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Ryan Fitzgerald misses field goal in Week 18
news.impact: Fitzgerald missed a 54-yard field goal on the opening drive of the second half. Carolina will need him to step up with the team heading into the postseason.

news.body: Spencer Shrader connected on all four of his field goal attempts and his lone extra point attempt in a 19-17 win over the Texans.
news.head: Spencer Shrader perfect in Week 3
news.impact: Shrader reportedly sustained a groin injury in warmups Sunday, but it did not impact his performance against Houston. Shrader made field goals from 37, 39, 53, and 58 yards to help pace the Colts to their first win of the season. Shrader and the Colts will take on the Commanders in Week 3.

news.body: Spencer Shrader went 3-for-3 on his field-goal attempts and 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts in Sunday night's 33-30 overtime loss to the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Spencer Shrader perfect in overtime loss Sunday
news.impact: Shrader did his job on Sunday night. He made all six of his kicks against the Chiefs, which left him with 12 points over the course of the night. That wasn't enough for Indianapolis to pick up the win in overtime, however, as they now drop to 0-2 on the season.

news.body: Spencer Shrader converted his only field goal attempt as well as two of his three extra point attempts to finish with five points in the Colts' 41-23 loss to the Baltimore Ravens in Week 1.
news.head: Spencer Shrader misses extra point in Week 1
news.impact: Shrader fell victim behind an underwhelming performance from the Indianapolis offense in the season opener. The kicker will hope for more opportunities in a difficult Week 2 contest against the Kansas City Chiefs.

news.body: Spencer Shrader is out for the season with a knee injury. A big blow to a promising start of the season for Shrader and the Colts.
news.head: Spencer Shrader out for season with knee injury
news.impact: The Colts will need to find a new kicker in his absence. There are options out there, but Shrader was looking solid through the first few weeks and his loss is unfortunate.

news.body: Tyler Bass converted his only field goal attempt as well as all three of his extra point attempts to finish with six points in the Bills' 24-16 win over the Los Angeles Chargers in Week 3.
news.head: Tyler Bass perfect in Week 3
news.impact: Bass has offered modest output to begin the season, recording five or more points in each of the first three contests. The kicker benefits from playing behind one of the more high-powered offenses on a regular basis, with a Week 4 contest against the New England Patriots up next.

news.body: Tyler Bass went 5-for-6 on his extra-point attempts in Thursday night's 41-31 win over the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Tyler Bass scores five points Thursday
news.impact: Bass ended Thursday night's game with a total of five points, but he missed one of his extra point attempts in this game, which was less than ideal. He should remain a solid fantasy option at the kicker position moving forward.

news.body: Tyler Bass hit all three of his PATs and all three of his field goal attempts on his way to 12 kicking points in the Bills’ 36-31 win over Houston.
news.head: Tyler Bass has big week in win over Houston
news.impact: Bass had himself a great week against the Texans defense, spurred by the amount of offense Josh Allen and the rest of the crew were getting. He should be a good value moving forward as part of this high-powered offense.

news.body: Tyler Bass restructured his contract with the Bills.
news.head: Tyler Bass restructures deal with Bills
news.impact: Bass was sidelined for all of last season with a hip/groin injury. He will earn $1 million in guaranteed money next season with a chance to earn up to $3.5 million in incentives.

news.body: Tyler Loop made both of his field goals and added four extra points in a 34-31 win over the Cowboys in Brazil in Week 3.
news.head: Tyler Loop nails 56-yard game-winning FG in Week 3
news.impact: Loop provided the heroics as he hit a 56-yard field goal with a second left in the game to break a 31-31 tie. The veteran kicker has made five of his six field goals and added 11 extra points through three games this season. He will be a strong fantasy option heading into Week 4 against the Titans.

news.body: Tyler Loop made 1-of-2 field goals and 2-of-2 extra point attempts in the Ravens loss to the Saints.
news.head: Tyler Loop makes one field goal in Week 2 loss
news.impact: Loop had a 49-yard field goal blocked in the first half, but made a 49-yard field goal in the second half. The Ravens take on the Cowboys in Week 3, which should provide Loop with plenty of chances in what should be a high scoring matchup.

news.body: Tyler Loop converted both of his field goal attempts as well as all five of his extra point attempts to finish with 11 points in a 41-23 Week 1 win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Tyler Loop racks up 11 points in Week 1 win
news.impact: Loop capitalized on every opportunity for head coach Jesse Minter, finishing with a perfect stat line in the Week 1 win. The kicker will look to take advantage of another favorable matchup in Week 2 against the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: Tyler Loop made one of his two field goals and all three of his extra points in a 26-24 loss to the Steelers in Week 18.
news.head: Tyler Loop misses potential game-winning FG in Week 18
news.impact: Loop hit a 40-yard field goal but he missed a potential game-winning 44-yard attempt with two seconds left in the fourth quarter. It was a costly miss as the Ravens' loss gave the Steelers the AFC North title and caused Baltimore to miss the playoffs. Overall, it was a strong rookie season for Loop, who hit 30 of his 34 attempts and missed just two of his 46 extra points.

news.body: Will Reichard connected on 3-of-3 field goals and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Will Reichard makes five kicks Sunday
news.impact: Reichard made field goals from 54, 56 and 43 yards out. He hit two huge field goals late in the fourth quarter to help Minnesota hold off the Bucs.

news.body: Will Reichard converted all three of his field goal attempts to finish with nine points in a Week 2 9-3 win over the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Will Reichard perfect in Week 2 win
news.impact: Reichard continues a strong start to the season, recording seven or more points in each of the first two games. The kicker will look to provide another solid performance against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in Week 3.

news.body: Will Reichard made his lone field goal attempt and all four extra points on Sunday.
news.head: Will Reichard connects on lone field goal Sunday
news.impact: Reichard made his field goal from 38 yards out. He remains a fairly reliable option for fantasy managers.

news.body: Will Reichard was a perfect 3-for-3 on field goals and also added an extra point in Minnesota's 16-3 win over Green Bay on Sunday.
news.head: Will Reichard boots three field goals in Week 18
news.impact: Reichard made field goals from 43, 25, and 37 yards out and closed out the season with three consecutive games of three made field goals. The second-year kicker was nearly perfect in 2025, going 33-of-35 on field goal tries and 31-of-31 on extra point attempts. Reichard has not missed a PAT in his first two seasons in the league (69-of-69).

news.body: Baker Mayfield (thumb) is expected to be sidelined for around three weeks.
news.head: Baker Mayfield (thumb) expected to miss three weeks
news.impact: Mayfield underwent an MRI on his thumb after Sunday's loss to the Vikings, and the results indicated that he will need to miss around three weeks while he recovers. The team is going to start undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels in his absence, which is likely bad news for the fantasy value of Emeka Egbuka, Bucky Irving, and Tampa Bay's entire offense for the next few weeks.

news.body: Baker Mayfield (thumb) suffered a dislocated thumb in the Bucs game against the Minnesota Vikings. He will undergo an MRI. Before exiting, he completed 17-of-34 passes for 217 yards with a touchdown and a pick.
news.head: Baker Mayfield (thumb) suffers dislocated thumb, will get MRI
news.impact: Mayfield has been struggling so far this season, and now has an injury to boot. His MRI will reveal more of the extent to his injury, and how long he might be out. It’s a tough blow for the Bucs, and it’s likely Jaylon Daniels will receive a start next week.

news.body: Baker Mayfield (thumb) exited Sunday’s contest between the Tampa Bay Buccaneers and Minnesota Vikings with an apparent thumb injury according to Rick Stroud.
news.head: Baker Mayfield (thumb) exits early Sunday
news.impact: Mayfield headed to the locker room after suffering the injury late in the fourth quarter, completing 17-of-34 pass attempts for 217 yards, one touchdown, and one interception prior to exiting. Jalon Daniels takes over behind center for head coach Todd Bowles.

news.body: Baker Mayfield (illness) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
news.head: Baker Mayfield (illness) off injury report for Sunday
news.impact: Mayfield was dealing with a minor illness earlier in the week, but he's over it now and carries no injury designation heading into the weekend. He should be a full go against the Vikings and will be looking to bounce back after a rough first two weeks to the season so far.

news.body: Bo Nix completed 17-of-34 passing attempts for 186 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception while adding seven yards and a touchdown on the ground in Sunday night's 30-26 win over the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Bo Nix scores three times in win Sunday
news.impact: Nix ended up having a good game on Sunday night. He was able to score three touchdowns in a big primetime win over the Rams, although he wasn't able to accumulate many total yards in the process. Either way, he probably won't be a good fantasy option over the next few weeks with a hard schedule coming up, but he will likely have value over the back half of the season.

news.body: Bo Nix completed 22 of his 31 passes for 288 yards, one touchdown, and one interception while adding five rushes for six yards in a 20-13 win over the Jaguars in Week 2.
news.head: Bo Nix throws for 288 yards, one TD in Week 2
news.impact: Nix and the Broncos got off to a very slow start on offense, scoring just two field goals heading into the fourth quarter. He then led two touchdown-scoring drives in the fourth quarter to complete the come-from-behind win. Nix has thrown for 419 yards and two touchdowns through the first two games of the season. He is looking like a QB2 in fantasy heading into Week 3's matchup against the Rams.

news.body: Bo Nix completed 17-of-28 passing attempts for 131 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in Monday night's 31-10 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Bo Nix struggles in loss Monday
news.impact: Nix had a poor performance on Monday night. He was held to just 131 passing yards on the night and wasn't able to get Denver's offense going, leading them to score just ten points en route to a blowout loss at the hands of their divisional rivals. He should improve and play better in more favorable matchups moving forward, but they will continue to have a tough schedule for the foreseeable future, so fantasy managers might be better off looking for another option for the time being.

news.body: Bo Nix will not play in the Broncos preseason opener against the Falcons.
news.head: Bo Nix will not play in preseason opener
news.impact: Nix is expected to play in the second and third preseason games. Jarrett Stidham and Sam Ehlinger will both play a half.

news.body: Brock Purdy completed 15-of-27 passes for 297 yards and four touchdowns in the 49ers 36-30 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.head: Brock Purdy tosses four touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Purdy also had a rushing score late that was called back on a penalty by George Kittle. His first passing touchdown was a completion to Mike Evans, who lateraled the ball to Deebo Samuel for the long score. He draws a tougher matchup against the Broncos next week.

news.body: Brock Purdy connected on 20-of-22 passes for 287 yards and two touchdowns, adding 30 yards and a touchdown on three carries in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Brock Purdy turns in tremendous effort against Dolphins
news.impact: Purdy is off to an outstanding start this season, and he could hardly have been more prolific in Sunday's rout of the Dolphins. The fifth-year QB has completed a ridiculous 80.4% of his passes so far, averaging 246 yards with a 5-1 TD/INT ratio through two games. Purdy has also rushed for 59 yards on eight carries, including a two-yard scoring scramble on Sunday. He'll be a QB to start against the Cardinals in Week 3.

news.body: Brock Purdy completed 25-of-34 passes for 205 yards, three touchdowns, and a pick in the 49ers' 27-7 win over the Rams on Thursday. He also ran five times for 29 yards.
news.head: Brock Purdy dismantles Rams defense in statement win
news.impact: Purdy was great in this game aside from a couple of hiccups, namely the interception. However, he did what he needed to and got the Niners into scoring position and helped them take advantage of the several short fields they inherited. Purdy should be a solid asset moving forward for fantasy.

news.body: Brock Purdy completed 19-of-27 passes for just 127 yards and one interception in the 49ers 13-3 loss to the Seahawks.
news.head: Brock Purdy shut down by Seattle defense Saturday
news.impact: Purdy was held to a season-low 127 yards and failed to reach 200 yards through the air in a game for just the third time in his nine starts. It was also his only start of the year without throwing a touchdown pass. He carried the ball twice for 21 yards and had San Francisco's longest run of the night (11 yards).

news.body: Bryce Young (knee) logged another full practice session on Thursday.
news.head: Bryce Young (knee) practices in full again Thursday
news.impact: Young is still listed on Carolina's injury report due to a knee issue of some kind, but it's not considered serious and hasn't prevented him from practicing in full all week so far. Look for him to play without limitations in Week 4.

news.body: Bryce Young (knee) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
news.head: Bryce Young (knee) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Young was dealing with a minor knee issue of some kind in Week 3, but he seems to be over it already, as he was able to practice in full at the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday. He should be good to go for Week 4, but his fantasy value will largely depend on the health of his receiving core this week, namely Jalen Coker (quad) and Xavier Legette (knee) against Detroit.

news.body: Panthers coach Dave Canales said Bryce Young (leg) will undergo imaging “just to make sure” on Monday.
news.head: Bryce Young (leg) to undergo imaging
news.impact: Young took a cleat to the leg, but he was able to finish Sunday's game against the Browns. It doesn't appear to be anything too serious, but it's still worth monitoring.

news.body: Bryce Young completed 26-of-48 passing attempts for 291 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in Sunday's 21-18 loss to the Cleveland Browns.
news.head: Bryce Young underwhelming in loss Sunday
news.impact: Young had a lot of passing attempts on Sunday, but he wasn't able to capitalize on that, finishing with just one touchdown and one interception in a loss to the Browns. He did rack up nearly 300 yards despite losing Jalen Coker (quad), however, so he could continue to be a viable streaming option moving forward.

news.body: Caleb Williams (hamstring) missed another practice for the Bears on Thursday.
news.head: Caleb Williams (hamstring) misses another practice Thursday
news.impact: Williams was sidelined for another practice on Thursday, which doesn't come as much of a surprise, given that he's a long-shot to play in Week 4. Fantasy managers of any Bears players should be gearing up for either Tyson Bagent or Case Keenum to start for Chicago against the Jets this week.

news.body: Caleb Williams did not practice on Thursday.
news.head: Caleb Williams (hamstring) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: Williams is likely to miss a second straight game this week.

news.body: Caleb Williams (hamstring) will not be present for Chicago's walkthrough on Wednesday.
news.head: Caleb Williams (hamstring) not practicing Wednesday
